title: Lodestone
summary: The Lodestone is an ancient three-sided stone that can create an anti-magic field to negate magic, preventing the casting of spells and invocation of Titans. It was protected by a defence mechanism in the form of numerous rock-like guardians, controlled and powered by the Lodestone itself.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
The Lodestone was left by the [[Casterwill family]] in a hidden underground passage on an uninhabited Indonesian island, to cause a drought of magic around [[Phoenix Volcano]], the resting place of the [[Legendary Titan]] of Rebirth, [[Phoenix]]. It was guarded by several [[Lodestone Guardian]]s, a defense mechanism controlled by the Lodestone. {{source|The Dead Magic Island}}

Years later, the Huntik team, on the trail of Phoenix, followed [[Nostradamus]]' quatrain "The stone with three sides threatens all". [[Tersly]] and [[Sophie]] assumed the stone must the Lodestone. After attempting to navigate their way through the labyrinth, the Huntik team returned to the entrance where the Lodestone had been the entire time. Lok was able to break the stone, albeit using the fist of one of the guardians, and summon the [[Willblade]], defeating the guardians and saving the team. {{source|The Dead Magic Island}} Using the fact that the [[Blood Spiral]] were unaware of the Lodestone's deactivation to their advantage, the team were able to launch a surprise attack on [[Shauna]] and [[Wind]]. {{source|The Phoenix's Ashes}}
